items.text: KnowRoaming provides a service that allows you to purchase and activate an eSIM with data service plans based on eSIM technology ("Service"). These terms and conditions ("Terms and Conditions") govern your use of the Service.

Please read these Terms and Conditions of service carefully as they are a legally binding agreement between you and KnowRoaming. If you do not agree with all of the below Terms and Conditions, then you are expressly prohibited from using KnowRoaming's Services and you must discontinue use immediately.

By registering or utilizing KnowRoaming services, the user agrees that KnowRoaming shall not be liable for any charges incurred by roaming on the user's mobile service providers network.The user agrees that it is their responsibility to verify that they are on the KnowRoaming network while they are abroad.
To use the Service, you must first register for an account on the KnowRoaming website. When you register, you must provide your first and last name, email address, and a password.

When purchasing a package as a guest, your email address will be linked to your purchase, and should you choose to complete your registration, you will be able to check your data balance and top up your eSIM at your convenience.

You can purchase eSIM plans on the KnowRoaming website. KnowRoaming may restrict the availability of plans to certain countries. When you purchase a plan, you will be charged immediately. You will then need to download the eSIM onto your device and activate it. The downloaded eSIM will remain on your device after the plan has expired or your credit has been depleted.

The duration of your plan will depend on the plan you purchase. Once your plan has expired or your data has been depleted, the Service will terminate. Packages must be activated within 90 days from purchase. KnowRoaming may also terminate your Service if you violate these Terms and Conditions.

Please note that certain products offered through our platform may not be eligible for the use of discount codes or promotional offers. These exclusions will be clearly indicated at the time of purchase and during the checkout process. KnowRoaming reserves the right to modify the list of products or services excluded from discount codes at any time without prior notice.

The user agrees to take responsibility to ensure their device is unlocked and eSIM compatible before using KnowRoaming's services. To make use of the Services, the user must first download the eSIM, then activate the attached data plan for service to commence. Downloading and activating the eSIM requires a stable Internet connection.

KnowRoaming shall use all reasonable endeavors to provide a high-quality service. As a caveat, KnowRoaming does not guarantee that the service will not be interrupted, provided on time, be safe or fault-free.

In using the Services provided by KnowRoaming, the user may not engage in any action that is abusive, illegal, fraudulent or that causes damage or impairment to the Network. Should the user commit any of these breaches, KnowRoaming may suspend the user's access to Services without refund.
The user may buy eSIMs on the KnowRoaming website. Payment is processed through an authorized agent of KnowRoaming.
All eSIMs are prepaid and prices are inclusive of sales tax or value-added tax.

A refund process is valid under certain conditions. If the user has not scanned the QR code, used the data plan, or if there is a known technical problem originating and acknowledged by KnowRoaming eSIM, a refund could be granted.
Should a user have any request, please email us at support@knowroaming.com.

No waiver of any provision of these Terms and Conditions will be effective unless in writing and signed by both parties.

Access to Benefits: To access these benefits, eligible Visa cardholders ("Eligible Cardholders") must:
Click on the Visa benefit banner located on the KnowRoaming homepage and select your applicable region.
Log in to an existing account or sign up and log in to a new account.
Enter their Visa card number in the verification panel.
Unlock your Visa benefits by following the instructions on the site.

Verification: Upon entering the Visa credit card number, the system will verify the eligibility of the cardholder. Eligible Cardholders will then be shown the benefits they are eligible for. If a cardholder is not eligible, a notification will be provided.
Device Requirements: Eligible Cardholders must have a mobile device that is eSIM enabled and not network locked to access the benefits.

blocks.text: The KnowRoaming Kreds and Rewards Programme (the "Programme") allows eligible customers to earn and redeem Kreds through qualifying activities on the KnowRoaming platform. By participating in the Programme, you agree to these terms.
Earning Kreds
Customers may earn Kreds through qualifying activities on the KnowRoaming website or app, including but not limited to:

items.text: Purchases: Customers may earn Kreds when purchasing data plans, top-ups, or other eligible services. The applicable Kreds reward rate may vary by product and will be displayed on the relevant product or promotion page.
Refunds or Reversals: If a purchase that generated Kreds is refunded, KnowRoaming reserves the right to deduct the corresponding Kreds from the customer's wallet.

Referrals: Customers may earn Kreds by referring new customers using a valid referral code. A referred customer may receive Kreds upon completing their first qualifying purchase. Once the referred customer completes the qualifying purchase, the referring customer may also receive Kreds. To qualify for the referral bonus, both the referring customer and the referred customer must each have completed at least one minimum real-cash purchase of USD $0.50. For the avoidance of doubt, the referring customer may satisfy this requirement at any time prior to or after making the referral.
After registering with a referral code and receiving your Kreds, you must make a qualifying purchase of at least $4.50 to redeem or apply the referral bonus.
Referral rewards are only valid for new KnowRoaming customers who have not previously created an account.
KnowRoaming reserves the right to modify Kreds earning rates, eligibility criteria, or promotional incentives at any time.

blocks.text: Kreds Wallet

items.text: Kreds earned through the Programme are stored in the customer's KnowRoaming wallet and may be applied toward eligible purchases on the KnowRoaming platform, subject to applicable redemption rules.
Kreds have no cash value and may only be used in accordance with these terms.

blocks.text: Expiration
Kreds must generally be used within 12 months of being issued unless otherwise specified. Expired Kreds will be automatically removed from the customer's wallet and cannot be reinstated.
Redemption

items.text: Kreds may be redeemed for eligible purchases on the KnowRoaming platform where redemption is supported.
KnowRoaming may establish minimum redemption thresholds, redemption limits, or other conditions from time to time.

blocks.text: Currency
Kreds are denominated in United States Dollars (USD). Where purchases are made in other currencies, exchange rates may apply and may fluctuate from time to time.
Programme Changes
KnowRoaming reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to:

items.text: Modify or discontinue the Programme
Change Kreds earning rates or referral rewards
Modify redemption rules
Change expiration periods
Introduce or remove promotions

blocks.text: Any such changes may take effect immediately upon publication on the KnowRoaming website.
Abuse and Fraud
KnowRoaming reserves the right to suspend or terminate participation in the Programme and remove Kreds from accounts where it reasonably suspects:

items.text: Fraudulent activity
Abuse of the referral system
Creation of multiple accounts
Manipulation of promotions
Violations of KnowRoaming's general Terms of Service

blocks.text: If a customer's KnowRoaming account is closed or terminated for any reason, any unused Kreds associated with the account may be forfeited.
Accounts found engaging in abusive or fraudulent behaviour may have all associated Kreds revoked without notice.
Non-Transferable
Kreds are non-transferable and may only be used by the account holder who earned them. Kreds may not be sold, exchanged, or transferred to another user.
No Cash Value
Kreds cannot be exchanged, refunded, or redeemed for cash.
General

items.text: Participation in the Programme is subject to KnowRoaming's general Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
KnowRoaming may interpret and administer the Programme at its reasonable discretion.
KnowRoaming is not responsible for any loss of Kreds resulting from technical errors, system failures, or unauthorized account access.
KnowRoaming may limit or restrict the combination of Kreds with other promotions, discounts, or referral rewards.
